authority: Exact source-definition census plus declared computational rules. These extensions are not silently identified with the twelve native rule schemas.

native_relationship.paths: Source-backed partial computational algebra over exact rational path coefficients. A formal operational interpretation into native Resolve has not been constructed. Storing a Python result as an atom is not such an interpretation.
native_relationship.words: Word is the supplied inductive natural-number type; append and endo are defined recursively without importing arithmetic. NativeComponentArithmetic supplies the constructed semiring to the existing native expression interpretation.
native_relationship.s4: Neither rational coefficients, inductive words, grouping policies nor arbitrary spectral descriptors are claimed to be generated by S4. Their inputs remain explicit.

path_grammar.context: A finite nonempty registry of distinct primitive IDs with source/target fields, exact rational arithmetic, sortable path records, and one identity-owning ledger. Optional descriptors must pass the source validation equations.
productions: Stage ::= Root(registry) | Successor(Stage), provided every parent word has an endpoint-compatible primitive extension
Observation ::= one of the declared readout/guard operations below, applied to records owned by the same ledger
path_grammar.closure: Each successful constructor registers immutable data and returns a same-ledger object of its declared class. Compose may return an empty weighted family; externally supplied path families must be nonempty. Recursive assembly histories preserve the actual operands and cut, not merely a factorization of the final coefficients.
equations: With parent slot pi(j) and sibling count m_i: L[j,i]=1_{pi(j)=i}; A[i,j]=1_{pi(j)=i}/m_i. Nonempty sibling families give A L = I.
Split(x)=(A x, x-L A x). Its remainder is in ker A. Reassemble(c,r)=L c+r for A r=0. These maps are inverse on the full child space and parent space times ker A.
decode is the inverse of encode ONLY on im L. It is not the averaging map on arbitrary child coefficients.
For a sewn product at a retained cut, coefficient(p concatenated q)=left(p)*right(q); parent slots recover the supplied operand records.
Associative path concatenation gives equal coefficient maps across bracketings; the stored assembly trees remain different.

word_grammar.production: Word ::= zero | suc Word (the imported inductive Nat type, not imported Nat arithmetic)
equations: append zero b=b; append (suc a) b=suc(append a b)
endo a zero=empty; endo a (suc b)=append a (endo a b)
word_grammar.native_execution: For every finite amplitude Expr, Bridge.execution supplies an actual native Resolve tree. Factor weights remain input; the computed answer is not admitted as a new literal seed.
word_grammar.geometric_boundary: ComponentPort requires M equiv Word. The source does not derive that geometric normal form or identify arbitrary native packages with Word.

word_operations.rule: Alias the imported inductive Nat type.
Recurse on the first word, copying its constructors onto the second.
Recurse on the second word, appending one copy of the first per successor; multiply is this endomorphism evaluation.
Inductive append unit, associativity, successor compatibility, commutativity and interchange proofs.
Endomorphism generator value, additivity and uniqueness from that value.
Annihilation, unit, distribution, endomorphism composition and commutativity.
Assemble the constructed operations and proofs into the Cubical Semiring record.
Interpret words in a supplied target semiring by zero/unit/addition recursion.
Prove numeral preserves unit, addition and constructed multiplication, and is the unique zero/unit/addition preserving map.

limits: Census completeness covers every function/method defined in retained_path_successor.py, including private guards/support, and every named definition in ComponentArithmetic.agda. Imported dependencies remain explicit source structure.
Exact rational tests exercise path equations on declared finite fixtures. The general split proof follows from A L=I; no global physical dynamics is inferred.
The word proof and its native expression bridge have their own fresh Agda receipts, not inferred from a Python reimplementation.
Signed and rational arithmetic extensions and all sector operations are outside this two-source census; this does not assert they are absent from Marici.
